thread:
Priya (PM): Quick planning thread: we need a crisp slice-onboarding and migration playbook for long-term routing policy rollout. Sales asks for booking windows and SLA language. I want a minimal launch cut we can ship in Q2.
Sam (Runtime): Agreed. High-level plan: feature-flag tenant routing, provide a managed migration pathway, and expose per-customer cutover params. Minimal safe path: rehearsal -> small canary -> staged ramp -> full flip.
Diego (SRE): Must add: load test against slice, eviction/runaway detection, and an emergency re-route to pooled instances. Also set a cap on concurrent migrations per region.
Nora (Sales): Enterprise asks: 1) ability to reserve a 2hr maintenance window, 2) optional on-call engineering for first 48h, 3) rehearsal session we can bill. If we can formalize this, customers will pay.
Ivy (Security): Two security conditions: key boundary checks (KMS) and retention of audit trails during migration. For Private customers include an airgap checklist.
Sam (Runtime): Example YAML for a migration job (sketch):
```
migration_job:
  rehearsal: true
  canary_pct: 5
  hold_periods:
    - 20m
    - 30m
  metrics_watch:
    - p50_latency
    - p99_latency
    - error_rate
  rollback_triggers:
    latency_increase_ms: 75
    error_rate_pct: 1.5
  fallback_target: shared-pool
  max_concurrent_per_region: 4
```
Diego (SRE): Notes: `max_concurrent_per_region` must be enforced by orchestration. Add circuit-breaker on KV pressure and a quick-evacuate API to move tenants back (best-effort cache preservation).
Priya (PM): Proposed launch gating checklist to ship this as "Early Access":
- feature-flagging infra in place
- perf/regression tests green
- SRE capacity reservation process defined
- runbook + emergency evacuation documented
- security signoff (KMS/audit)
- sales handshake + billing term template
If anything missing, block EA.
Nora (Sales): Sales preference: gate to Dedicated + Private for EA. We'll include a paid "Managed Migration" add-on: 2hr window + standby eng + rehearsal. I'll prepare contract language.
Ivy (Security): Gate sounds good. Private customers will still need on-prem validation. Also require that rehearsals cannot exfiltrate telemetry out of the customer's network unless explicitly allowed.
infra-bot: deploy-notice: "router-feature-flags: tenant-routing v1 scheduled for staged rollout 2026-06-10T09:00:00Z"
Sam (Runtime): Implementation risks: atomic routing table updates per region (need quick coordination service), router decision added to hot path for per-tenant lookups (low-cost but needs perf validation), and observability hooks to attribute cost/latency per tenant. Rough dev estimate: 3 sprints + 1 stabilization sprint.
Diego (SRE): I'll own evacuation doc and load-test template. Also propose adding a new alert channel for migration incidents.
Priya (PM): Prioritized backlog (initial): 1) per-tenant routing lookup and atomic rollout 2) migration job controller + constraints 3) observability + billing attribution 4) docs + sales materials 5) rollback automation.
Nora (Sales): I'll draft Managed Migration pricing tiers: Basic (rehearsal + scheduling), Standard (2hr window + email support), Premium (2hr window + eng standby 48h). Share tomorrow.
Ivy (Security): I'll create the KMS validation checklist and rehearse privacy constraints for telemetry during rehearsals.
Sam (Runtime): I'll open an RFC with config examples, router perf targets, and a safe-default policy that keeps fallback to shared-pool. Will include automated canary progression logic.
Priya (PM): Decision point for leadership: do we restrict routing-based slice onboarding to Dedicated/Private for first 6 months? Pros: lower support cost, easier monetization, lower blast radius. Cons: slows adoption. Thoughts?
Nora (Sales): Strongly prefer gating to Dedicated/Private initially. We can upsell capacity commitments.
Diego (SRE): Technical vote: gate it. Limits help with SRE runbook and capacity planning.
Ivy (Security): Gate it. Private deployments frequently have extra constraints that align with our plan.
Priya (PM): Consensus to gate to Dedicated/Private for EA. I'll mark iniciativa as "EA: Dedicated/Private only" and capture the playbook above. We'll reconvene when Sam posts the RFC. Thanks everyone :rocket:
